title: Former WADA chief Craig Reedie dead at 84
byline: Veteran British sports administrator Craig Reedie, a former head of the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and a key figure in London’s successful bid to stage the 2012 Olympic Games, has died aged 84 it was announced on Monday.

title: SLC’s Jaffna Sports City Under Scrutiny
byline: Eye-brows and questions have been raised over the proposed construction of what is being touted as the Jaffna Sports City in Mandathivu that was adopted by Sri Lanka Cricket at what was called an Extraordinary General Meeting held yesterday at the Cinnamon Grand Hotel in Colombo.

title: No unannounced power cuts: Minister refutes allegations
byline: Whilst dismissing the allegations of unannounced power cuts, Minister of Power and Energy Kumara Jayakody told Parliament today that announcements will be made if scheduled power cuts are implemented.

title: SLTB, Railways announce special transport services for New Year travellers
byline: The Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB) has announced that a special bus service will be operated from April 9 to facilitate passengers travelling to their hometowns for the Sinhala and Tamil New Year.

title: Sri Lanka U19 Women 53/3 after choosing to bat vs England
byline: Sri Lanka Women Under-19 were 53 for 3 after 16 overs against England in the Women’s Under-19 Tri-Series in Australia 2026, after opting to bat first.

title: President to present concessional package to Parliament today: Leader of the House
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake will present a concessional package in Parliament today, specially designed for the public, Leader of the House Bimal Ratnayake told the House.

title: ’’There was always someone above Zahran’’– Easter Sunday attack victims
byline: Amid a fresh wave of claims and counterclaims over the alleged mastermind behind the Easter Sunday terror attacks, family members of the victims are of the opinion that there was always someone above Zaharan Hashim before the attacks were launched.

title: Wild elephants roam, school children on holiday
byline: The wild elephant conflict in the Hambantota area has resulted in the closure of Welipatanwila Maha Vidyalaya in Nonagama in Hambantota education zone.

title: Avurudu Koha goes silent this year
byline: The song of the Avurudu Koha, known as the Asian Koel (Eudynamys scolopaceus), is a familiar feature during the Sinhala and Tamil New Year season, along with the ripening of fruits in nature. People often feel nostalgic when they hear the bird’s call, which heralds the arrival of Avurudu.

title: Little hero in Kotmale
byline: A heroic deed of a little boy who saved his parents and sister from imminent death when they received serious injuries in a road accident was reported yesterday from Thawalanthenna, Kotmale.

title: Politicians get together despite being in different camps: SJB MP
byline: Politicians from different parties come together on various occasions despite being in opposing political camps, Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) MP Sujith Sanjaya Perera said.

title: Sinopec increases Super Diesel price
byline: Sinopec, the leading Chinese petroleum company has increased the price of Super Diesel with effect from today (07).

title: Assets branded differently for Govt, opposition: Namal
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organizer and Parliamentarian Namal Rajapaksa claimed that a double standard exists in how wealth is perceived in politics, alleging that assets held by government figures are described as “social capital,” while those linked to the opposition are labelled as “theft.”

title: Trump threatens to take out Iran in ’one night’ if no deal before deadline
byline: US President Donald Trump has threatened to take out Iran ’’in one night’’ if it fails to make a deal before the deadline he set for Tehran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy route.

title: Discharge delays fuel public dissatisfaction: Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa says
byline: Growing delays in hospital discharge procedures are fueling public dissatisfaction with Sri Lanka’s health system, Doctors’ Trade Union Alliance for Medical and Civil Rights President Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa said.

title: NDB fraud exposes control gaps as losses climb to Rs.13.2bn
byline: A control failure that began beneath the surface has now forced National Development Bank PLC (NDB) to confront a multi-billion-rupee fraud, testing both its governance framework and the broader confidence in the banking system.

title: Government hopeful of receiving IMF 4th, 5th tranche by end May: President
byline: The government is hopeful of receiving the fourth and fifth tranches of USD 700 million from the International Monitory Fund (IMF) by end of May, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said today.

title: Pre-feasibility study underway on resuming Mannar-Rameswaram ferry service: Minister
byline: The government is conducting a pre-feasibility study on resuming passenger ferry services between Mannar and Rameswaram, Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation Anura Karunathilaka said today.

title: Diesel, petrol concessions for three months from May
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake announced a series of relief measures, including fuel concessions and financial support, aimed at easing the burden on the public.

title: Israeli military tells people in Iran to avoid using trains
byline: The Israeli military on Tuesday told ​people in Iran not ‌to use trains or go near railway ​lines.

title: Over 400 school dropouts due to abuse, violence: PM
byline: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya revealed today that some 425 children have left school, while six have committed suicide due to abuse and violence in both government and private schools so far from 2025.

title: Are we seeing AI Sajith in Parliament today?
byline: Exhibiting a sense of humour, Leader of the House Bimal Ratnayake questioned whether the MPs are seeing AI-generated Opposition Leaders in the House today.

title: Sri Lanka Women U19 have won the toss and have opted to bat
byline:
Series: Women’s Under-19 Tri-Series in Australia, 2026
Sri Lanka Women U19 vs England Women U19, 2nd unofficial ODI

title: Trump threatens jail for reporter who revealed Iran airman rescue
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday he would demand that the journalist who ​first reported that an airman in Iran had been rescued reveal how they ‌got that information, and threatened to jail them if they refused.

title: Scheduled water cuts announced as reservoir levels drop
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced scheduled water supply suspensions as reservoir levels feeding the Labugama and Kalatuwawa water treatment plants continue to decline due to the prevailing dry weather.

title: Govt to offer electricity concessions for low-usage households
byline: The government has decided to introduce concessions for households that consume low units of electricity, Cabinet Spokesman and Minister Vijith Herath said.

title: Cabinet approves amendment to Finance Act on telecom tower levy
byline: The Cabinet has approved amendments to the Finance Act No. 35 of 2018 concerning the levy imposed on telecommunication towers.

title: Cabinet approves VAT amendment bill ahead of parliament submission
byline: The Cabinet has approved steps to amend the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, in line with proposed tax policy changes outlined in the 2025 and 2026 budgets.

title: Cabinet approves new commissioner general of Registration of Persons
byline: The Cabinet has approved the appointment of a new Commissioner General of Registration of Persons to fill the existing vacancy in the Department of Registration of Persons.

title: Cabinet approves procurement of surgical gauze from local manufacturers
byline: The Cabinet has approved the procurement of surgical gauze for the Medical Supplies Sector for the year 2026 from local manufacturers, in line with an earlier decision to support domestic production.

title: Govt to launch digital marketplace to streamline public procurement
byline: The Sri Lankan government is set to create and develop a centralized GovTech App/Service Marketplace under its Digital Public Infrastructure initiative, aiming to streamline and modernize public sector technology procurement.

title: Bribery Commission sets deadline for Mahinda Rajapaksa’s asset disclosure
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC ) has directed former President Mahinda Rajapaksa to submit a fully completed affidavit detailing his assets, expenses, and sources of income by April 10, 2026.

title: Oil prices climb as Hormuz stays shut ahead of Trump deadline
byline: Oil ​prices extended gains on Tuesday as a U.S.-imposed deadline loomed for Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz or be ’’taken ‌out’’, with U.S. President Donald Trump threatening to order attacks on Iranian bridges and power plants.

title: Iran’s new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei unconscious and in a ‘severe condition’, leaked memo suggests
byline: Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran’s newest Supreme Leader following the assassination of his father, is in a “severe condition” and cannot take part in the regime’s decision-making, according to a leaked diplomatic memo.

title: Nuwara Eliya PS Chairman arrested over corruption allegations
byline: The Chairman of the Nuwara Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha, which is under the control of the National People’s Power (NPP), was arrested this morning (April 7) by officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption over allegations of corruption.

title: Amber alert issued for severe lightning across several provinces
byline: The Meteorology Department has issued an Amber-level advisory warning of severe lightning activity in parts of the country, effective until 11.00 p.m. today (07).

title: Iran war jeopardizes U.S. global leadership, warns Italian minister
byline: The Iran war has put U.S. global leadership on the line, Italy’s Defence Minister Guido Crosetto said, expressing fear about the ’’madness’’ of nuclear escalation.

title: Moon fly-by sees astronauts regain contact with Earth and head for home
byline: Four astronauts on Nasa’s Artemis II mission are on their way back home after a dramatic lunar fly-by that saw them travel further from Earth than any other humans.

title: Government hopeful of receiving IMF 5th, 6th tranche by end May: President
byline: The government is hopeful of receiving the fifth and sixth tranches of USD 700 million from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) by the end of May, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said today.

title: Land release in focus at Defence Committee Meeting
byline: The Ministerial Consultative Committee on Defence convened in Parliament this afternoon (07) under the patronage of Anura Kumara Dissanayake, in his capacity as Minister of Defence.

title: First photo from far-side of the moon released
byline: The White House released the first photo taken by the Artemis II crew of the far side of the Moon on Tuesday.

title: Market reverses early gains amid rising uncertainty
byline: The Colombo bourse experienced a mixed trading session, as early bullish momentum faded amid weakening investor confidence. The ASPI surged over 186 points within the first half hour of trading, reflecting initial optimism. However, the rally proved short-lived, with the index gradually declining throughout the session as sentiment turned cautious.

title: Trump threatens to destroy ’’a whole civilization’’
byline: President Trump said Tuesday morning, about his looming deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz or face, that ’’a whole civilization will die tonight,’’ adding that he didn’t ’’want that to happen, but it probably will.’’

title: Tamim Iqbal Becomes BCB President After Ex-Chief Punished For T20 World Cup Fiasco
byline: Former opener Tamim Iqbal has been fast-tracked into cricket administration, taking charge of the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) at a turbulent moment for the game in the country, with the government stepping in to overhaul the existing set-up after weeks of mounting unrest and resignations.

title: Court rules Devalaya funds subject to public scrutiny under RTI
byline: The Court of Appeal has ruled that funds held by Devalayas cannot be treated as private accounts and must be open to public scrutiny, reinforcing the principles of transparency and accountability in the management of religious institutions.

title: Domestic gas prices adjusted due to global market pressures
byline: Domestic gas prices have been revised following a sharp rise in international LPG rates, the government announced.

title: Sri Lanka U19 Women hammer England by 52 runs
byline: Sri Lanka Under-19 Women secured a convincing 52-run victory over England Under-19 Women in the second match of the Women’s U19 Tri-Series in Australia.

title: Trump threatens jail for reporter who revealed Iran airman rescue
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday he would demand that the journalist who ​first reported that an airman in Iran had been rescued reveal how they ‌got that information, and threatened to jail them if they refused.

title: Iran threatens Bab al-Mandeb closure: How would that affect world trade?
byline: A top adviser to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has threatened that Iranian allies could shut the Bab al-Mandeb shipping route as Tehran has effectively done with the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Together for Health: Stand with Science
byline: On this World Health Day (7 April), we are reminded of a simple yet powerful truth: health is not static, and neither are the challenges we face. This year’s theme, ’Together for Health. Stand with Science’ calls on us not just to trust science, but to actively use it to navigate an increasingly complex world.

title: Qatar warns Iran war could now ’spiral out of control’
byline: In a series of direct warnings and as the US deadline for Iran approached later on Tuesday, Qatar’s foreign ministry called for “a way of ending the war before it spiralls out of control”, adding that there was still time for diplomacy to prevail, “before it escalates beyond anyone’s control”.

title: Market reverses early gains amid rising uncertainty
byline: The Colombo bourse experienced a mixed trading session, as early bullish momentum faded amid weakening investor confidence. The ASPI surged over 186 points within the first half hour of trading, reflecting initial optimism. However, the rally proved short-lived, with the index gradually declining throughout the session as sentiment turned cautious.

title: Renovated Fort Central Bus Stand to open tomorrow
byline: The official opening of the renovated Fort Central Bus Stand will take place tomorrow (8) at 10.00 a.m. under the patronage of Transport, Highways and Urban Development Minister Bimal Rathnayake.

title: Nuwara Eliya PS Chairman, CWC Deputy Leader Velu Yogaraj remanded
byline: The Chairman of the Nuwara Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha and Deputy Leader of the CWC, Velu Yogaraj, who was arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption over allegations of corruption, was remanded till April 17 by the Colombo Chief Magistrate’s Court.

title: Iranian artist Ali Ghamsari performs in front of power plant amid Trump’s ‘8 PM Eastern Time’ deadline
byline: In a powerful display of resistance, an Iranian musician named Ali Ghamsari was seen performing outside a power plant amid US President Donald Trump’s looming deadline to hit the Iranian civilian infrastructure if no deal is made by Tuesday.
